description: This file is a CMake module script that detects hardware features and instruction set support (such as NEON, SVE, and OMAP processors) on ARM-based systems during the build configuration process. It includes logic for different operating systems and performs compile tests for advanced instruction support.

methods.name: CHECK_COMPILES
methods.description: Macro to check if specific C or C++ source code compiles successfully with given compiler flags, indicating support for certain instruction sets.
